purpose: Map imported Sigma history into the active Invariant goal. This is a research queue, not a list of surviving theories or an exhaustive search.
history_class: Previously exposed, heterogeneous development and diagnostic summaries; historical holdout labels do not confer new independence.

directions.next_discriminating_work: Define one independently measured invariant coherence field; derive reciprocal matter coupling and its dynamics. Audit the exact input implementation for response reuse and object-dependent phase factors before any prediction claim.
directions.warning: The old document uses observed velocity structure in one phase proxy and fitted phase/size prescriptions. This does not establish that every later implementation uses the same inputs.

directions.name: Measured density and kinematic coherence interpolation
directions.next_discriminating_work: Avoid another sweep of the same local logistic law. A new nonspherical action or independently measurable source would be a materially different hypothesis.

directions.name: Coherent monopole about the baryonic center
directions.next_discriminating_work: Any successor must derive source-reaction terms from an action and test cluster separation, total force and torque before observations. Do not merely subtract the mean acceleration after solving.
directions.warning: This audit covers the base. The P0697 routed addition and later source blends are different operators; their historical empirical failures are recorded separately.

directions.name: Local vector coherence
directions.formula: C=|sum_j g_Nj|/sum_j|g_Nj|; S_base=C*S_coh+(1-C)*S_local, with the registered boundary and routing term
directions.next_discriminating_work: A new continuum action must define the scalar denominator independent of arbitrary source partition, carry reaction forces, and explain why cancellations encode the relevant physics.
directions.warning: The historical code uses source-cell convolution, not an arbitrary catalogue sum. Its disk cancellations selected the wrong endpoint; do not repair this with an object label.

directions.name: Barycentric radial alignment
directions.formula: A_r=max(0,-g_N dot rhat)/|g_N|; S_base=A_r*S_coh+(1-A_r)*S_local, with the registered boundary and routing term
directions.next_discriminating_work: Use a physically distinct directional source if developing a new law. Net-field angle to one global center did not distinguish multi-center structure in the historical scenes.
directions.warning: Both development systems are spent. No further formula selection on their residuals is proposed here.

directions.warning: The historical inference that raw lens topology needs richer spatial response is a hypothesis generator, not a theorem that all scalar theories fail.
